description: Typography parity contract for every canonical CorOS app state. Coverage is inherited from the executable 103-state screen ledger; every rendered text run is measured for content, line geometry, face, size, weight, style, color, background, alignment, direction, writing mode, spacing, and wrapping on Windows and Android.

sourceEvidence.scope: Cortex Control desktop chrome, not proof of the CorOS framebuffer face
sourceEvidence.note: The desktop executable embeds IBM Plex Sans, but the full physical-framebuffer comparison scores lower when IBM Plex is forced across CorOS. CorOS reconstruction therefore retains the empirically superior bundled Arimo/Roboto mapping until firmware font resources can be extracted directly.
